widgets_values: The camera pushes slowly along a cobbled side street in an old European city on a bright autumn morning, past a red vintage car parked at the kerb and the outdoor tables of a small cafe where a young woman reads a newspaper and an older man talks on the phone.

The target video is a photoreal, naturally lit street film in the look of a European travel documentary, shot on a 35 mm lens with soft contrast, fine film grain and the cool, even light of a clear morning, the narrow strip of pale sky between the tall buildings bright and slightly hazy. [Shot 1] The camera glides forward at walking pace along the grey stone pavement of a narrow cobbled street lined with tall ochre and sandstone buildings of five and six storeys, their tall shuttered windows, iron balconies and carved cornices receding toward a distant crossroads. On the left a small cherry red vintage car with chrome bumpers, round headlights and a cream interior is parked against the kerb, its glossy paint reflecting the street. To the right a cafe with a red and white striped scalloped awning, brass wall lamps and dark wooden window frames sets out round white marble tables and woven rattan bistro chairs on the pavement. Red geraniums spill from window boxes above the tables, and a hand-chalked menu board leans against the wall beside two parked bicycles. A young woman with long brown hair in a mustard yellow raincoat sits at a table reading a folded newspaper, a white espresso cup and saucer in front of her. A small brown dachshund lies on the cobbles at her feet, chin on its paws. At the next table an older man in a grey flat cap, glasses and a navy cardigan holds a phone to his ear, a cup of coffee before him. Further along the pavement a man in a dark navy coat walks toward the camera carrying green and yellow shopping bags, and a woman in a red coat walks away in the distance. The camera keeps moving smoothly forward along the pavement with a slight steady sway, the car sliding past on the left and the cafe tables growing larger on the right, revealing more of the cobbles, chair legs and table bases as it advances. The woman turns a page of her newspaper, the man nods as he listens, the dachshund lifts its head and looks toward the camera, and the walking man passes the parked bicycles. Leaves stir faintly in the window boxes and steam curls from the cups.
Quiet street ambience, a cup set down on a saucer, distant footsteps on cobbles and soft city murmur.
